verdict.rationale: The evidence documents short-term, thread-scoped memory via checkpointers and says nodes can be arbitrary state-manipulation functions. It never shows a first-party capability to trim, summarize, or filter message history to fit a context window. Arbitrary nodes are only a developer building block for constructing such logic, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trim, summarize, or filter conversation history to keep an agent inside its context window
